{{Current events|year=2026|month=05|day=15|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[Antisemitism during the 2026 Iran war]]
****Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood al-Saadi, a commander of the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|IRGC]]-aligned [[Shia Islam in Iraq|Shia Iraqi]] militia group [[Kata'ib Hezbollah]], is arrested in [[Turkey]] by the [[United States Department of Justice|U.S. justice department]] after allegedly planning attacks on [[Judaism in the United States|Jewish]] sites in the [[United States]], along with attacks in [[Europe]] as part of a broader campaign of retaliation by [[Iran]] over the war. [https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/2026-05-15/ty-article/.premium/iran-linked-militia-commander-arrested-for-planning-attacks-on-u-s-jewish-sites/0000019e-2d18-d605-abbe-ed1f85a80000 (''Haaretz'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/15/nyregion/hezbollah-arrest-nyc-jewish-targets.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] says that he is open to accepting Iran's 20-year suspension on their [[Nuclear program of Iran|nuclear program]] if Iran gives a real guarantee. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/trump-says-hes-ok-with-iran-suspending-nuke-program-for-20-years-if-theres-a-real-commitment/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[2026 Lebanon war]]
***[[2026 Israel–Lebanon peace talks]]
****The [[United States]] announces that [[Israel]] and [[Lebanon]] agreed to extend their [[2026 Israel–Lebanon ceasefire|ceasefire]] for 45 days, and that more specific political and security negotiations will begin on May 29 and June 2, respectively. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/us-announces-45-day-extension-of-porous-lebanon-ceasefire-after-3rd-round-of-beirut-jlem-talks/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/israel-and-lebanon-agree-to-45-day-extension-of-ceasefire-u-s-state-department-says (PBS)]
***Israeli [[airstrike]]s kill at least seven people across [[Nabatieh]], [[Tibnin]], and [[Harouf]], and injure 37 people in [[Tyre, Lebanon]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/iran-war-latest-254-people-killed-by-israeli-strikes-in-lebanon-today-says-civil-defence-service-13509565 (Sky News)]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Hamas]] military leader [[Izz al-Din al-Haddad]] is [[Assassination|assassinated]] alongside his wife and daughter in an Israeli airstrike in [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/gaza-mosques-announce-death-hamas-military-leader-after-israeli-targeting-claim-2026-05-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[Killing of Abu-Bilal al-Minuki]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that [[United States Armed Forces|U.S.]] and [[Nigeria]]n [[Nigerian Armed Forces|forces]] have eliminated [[Islamic State|ISIS]] second-in-command [[Abu-Bilal al-Minuki]] during a joint mission. [https://abujapolitico.com/us-nigerian-forces-kill-second-in-command-of-islamic-state-in-africa-operation/ (Abuja Politico)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-says-us-kills-islamic-state-leader-in-nigeria/ (CBS News)]
**Seventeen police trainees and an unknown number of soldiers are killed in a [[mass shooting]] by Islamist militants at a specialised military school in [[Buni Yadi]], [[Yobe State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/islamist-attack-nigerian-military-school-kills-17-police-trainees-2026-05-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Prisoners of war in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)| Prisoners of war in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Russia]] and [[Ukraine]] [[prisoner exchange|swap]] 205 [[Prisoners of war in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|prisoners of war]] following a violated [[May 2026 Russo-Ukrainian truce|three-day ceasefire]]. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/05/15/ukraine-and-russia-swap-205-prisoners-of-war-each-in-us-brokered-exchange (Euronews)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[2026 Blue Nile campaign]]
***The [[Sudanese Army]] says that they have re-captured the [[Blue Nile State|Blue Nile]] town of [[Khor Hassan]] from [[Rapid Support Forces]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2026/5/16/sudanese-army-captures-key-town-near-ethiopian-border-from-rsf (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Anti-fur movement]]
**The [[Camera Nazionale della Moda Italiana]], which organizes [[Milan Fashion Week]] in [[Italy]], announces guidelines encouraging participating brands not to display [[Fur clothing|fur products]] during [[fashion show]]s following pressure from [[Animal welfare and rights in Italy|animal rights]] groups. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20260515-milan-fashion-week-says-will-ask-brands-not-to-show-fur (AFP via RFI)]
*The "Recently Played" feature on Audacy's website for [[Mix 104.1]] suffers a multi-day shutdown. For four days, it is stuck at 2:02 p.m., when the last recorded song was "[[Dilemma (Nelly song)|Dilemma]]" by Nelly. As of Tuesday, May 19, [https://www.audacy.com/stations/mix1041#recently-played this page] does not show a "Recently Played" list at all. Hopefully, this is just a temporary "transition period" that will be resolved after a few more days. 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Drought in Somalia]]
**All [[UN agencies]] warn that the [[Somalia]]n [[hunger]] and [[malnutrition]] crisis is rapidly worsening, with a growing risk of [[famine in Somalia|famine]]. More than 6 million people, approximately 31% of the population, face critical levels of [[food insecurity]], while nearly 1.9 million children are suffering from [[acute malnutrition]]. Of those children, approximately 493,000 are facing [[global acute malnutrition|severe acute malnutrition]]. [https://v.aa.com.tr/3938671 (AA)] [https://reliefweb.int/node/4212109 (Relief Web)] [https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/05/1167516 (UN News)]
*[[Famine in Sudan (2024–present)|Famine in Sudan]]
**The [[Integrated Food Security Phase Classification]] warns that 19.5 million people in [[Sudan]] are facing hunger amidst the three-year [[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|civil war]]. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20260515-monitoring-group-says-19-5-million-people-face-severe-hunger-in-sudan/ (Middle East Monitor)]
*Six people are killed and 19 others injured in a collision between a passenger bus and a cargo truck in [[Hadramout]], [[Yemen]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260516/a2cfc24745a143eab8bb0322dd49bad5/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Six people are killed and 10 others were injured after a speeding tanker hit the vehicle they were traveling in from behind in [[Karnataka]], [[India]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260516/e9da84de30134102900b2457057671dc/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Ituri Province Ebola epidemic]]
**An [[ebola]] outbreak is confirmed in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]'s [[Ituri Province]] by the [[Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention]], killing 80 people. [https://apnews.com/article/ebola-congo-ituri-africa-virus-d59a194e6032e1783b6085b56d84b0f0 (AP)] [https://news.sky.com/story/new-ebola-outbreak-in-congo-kills-65-13544395 (Sky News)]
**The [[Ministry of Health (South Sudan)|South Sudan Health Ministry]] issues an ebola alert in [[South Sudan|the country]] following cases in the DRC and [[Uganda]]. [https://www.radiotamazuj.org/en/news/article/south-sudan-issues-ebola-alert-as-congo-cases-raise-fears (Radio Tamazuj)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–United States relations]]
**[[2026 state visit by Donald Trump to China]], [[China–United States trade war]]
***[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (China)|Chinese foreign minister]] [[Wang Yi]] says that [[China]] and the [[United States]] have agreed to continue implementing previous [[trade agreement]]s and to establish [[Labour council|trade and investment councils]] following talks between [[Paramount leader|Chinese leader]] [[Xi Jinping]] and [[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] in [[Beijing]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2026/05/15/china-says-agrees-with-us-to-implement-all-existing-trade-agreements (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
*[[Foreign involvement in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Foreign involvement in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**Thirty-six countries and the [[European Union]] join the [[Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression against Ukraine]]. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/05/15/point-of-no-return-36-countries-join-special-tribunal-to-prosecute-vladimir-putin (Euronews)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Two [[Mexico|Mexican]] [[Government of Mexico|officials]] sought for extradition by the U.S. in April on charges of alleged [[collusion]] with [[List of Mexican cartels|organized crime]] are reportedly detained in Europe and the U.S. [https://tribunademexico.com/detenidos-funcionarios-sinaloa/ (''Tribuna de México'' {{small|in Spanish}})]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Constitutional crisis in Somalia]]
**[[Controversies of Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]]
***A third day of talks mediated by the [[UK]] and [[US]] between the [[Somali federal government]] and the opposition [[Somali Future Council]] are collapsing over their legal future and the electoral process after [[Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]] broke his [[President of Somalia#Term of office|constitutional presidential term limit]]. His four-year [[Constitution of Somalia|constitutional term]] is formally expiring on 15 May, but it is ending with no plan for an [[2026 Somali presidential election|upcoming election]]. [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/collapse-of-halane-talks-pushes-somalia-into-a-new-political-crisis-over-elections (Garowe Online)] [https://horseedmedia.net/somalia-talks-end-without-breakthrough-as-election-dispute-deepens/421688/ (Horseed Media)] [https://addisstandard.com/somalia-government-opposition-hold-talks-amid-deepening-constitutional-crisis/ (Addis Standard)]
*[[Matthew Wale]] is appointed as the [[prime minister of Solomon Islands|prime minister]] of [[Solomon Islands]] after [[Jeremiah Manele]] was ousted in a [[no-confidence vote]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/may/15/matthew-wale-elected-solomon-islands-prime-minister (''The Guardian'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[Boycott of Russia and Belarus]]
**The [[United World Wrestling]] lifts restrictions on wrestlers from [[Russia]] and [[Belarus]] that was imposed following the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|Russian invasion of Ukraine]] and will allow them to compete under their respective [[Flag of Russia|national]] [[Flag of Belarus|flags]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/russian-belarusian-wrestlers-can-compete-under-their-national-flags-uww-says-2026-05-15/ (Reuters)]
